title: VendPoint Placement Terms Schedule: Installation, Term, Notice, Moves and Data
content:
Schedule to the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program placement terms. Each figure applies to the machine model named at the head of its column.

| | VendPoint Locker 12 | VendPoint Locker 24 | VendPoint Coil 40 | VendPoint Coil 60 | VendPoint Carousel 90 | VendPoint Smart Crib 300 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Installation fee, USD (one-time) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 250.00 | 1500.00 |
| Installation lead, business days from request | 10 | 10 | 15 | 15 | 20 | 45 |
| Minimum placement term, months from installation | 12 | 12 | 24 | 24 | 36 | 36 |
| Removal notice, calendar days of written notice | 30 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 60 | 90 |
| Early removal fee, USD (removal before the minimum term ends) | 500.00 | 750.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 3500.00 | 12000.00 |
| Relocation fee, USD (move to another location or ship-to) | 150.00 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 | 400.00 | 2500.00 |
| Relocations per rolling 12 months without the fee | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Relocation scheduling, business days | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 30 |
| Model swap fee, USD (swap for another VendPoint model) | 250.00 | 250.00 | 300.00 | 300.00 | 500.00 | 2500.00 |
| Cellular data fee, USD per month (site provides no network connection) | 15.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 |

### Points of reading

- Installation lead and relocation scheduling are counted in business days; removal notice is counted in calendar days.
- The minimum placement term is counted in months from the installation date.
- A model whose installation fee is 0.00 USD, and the VendPoint Smart Crib 300 cellular data fee of 0.00 USD, are amounts of zero on the schedule.
- The relocation allowance is a count of relocations within a rolling 12 months; a model with 0 included relocations has no relocation without the fee.
